task.title: Create your first world
task.shortdesc: Create a new single-player world with beginner-friendly settings.

context.p: For your first session, a Survival world on Easy or Peaceful difficulty reduces pressure while you learn movement and crafting.

step.cmd: From the title screen, choose Singleplayer, then Create New World.
Enter a world name you will recognize later.
Set Game Mode to Survival (or Creative if you only want to practice building).
Set Difficulty to Peaceful or Easy for a gentler start.
Optional: open More World Options and leave bonus chest enabled if you want starter supplies near spawn.
Choose Create New World and wait for terrain generation to finish.

result.p: You spawn in the world. Note your coordinates or build a simple landmark so you can find your first base after exploring.
